subject: Azalea Tech vendor enablement — privacy verification + PO routing
content:
From: Sophie Park <sophie@azaleatech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor enablement — Azalea Tech (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Azalea connected. Procurement asked us to provide the DPA signature and SOC 2 evidence before they can issue a PO. Can you confirm the exact artifacts you need and the PO flow?

High level:
- We can execute a DPA via DocuSign (happy to sign your standard).
- We have an unredacted SOC 2 Type II report (Sept 2028) — are redacted copies acceptable?
- We maintain a subprocessor list but can provide a CSV if that’s preferred.

Also attaching our completed vendor intake form (Azalea_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf).

Main asks: 1) Where do we upload the DPA? 2) What SOC 2 link or format do you need? 3) PO timing and invoice routing.

Thanks,
Sophie Park
Head of Partnerships
Azalea Tech

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@azaleatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enablement — Azalea Tech (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Hi Sophie — great to meet you, and thanks for the intake form. I pulled procurement + security details below so we have everything in one thread.

Quick answers up front:
- DPA: please sign our DPA via DocuSign link (DocuSign link included below). We prefer the signed DPA back to be accessible from the DocuSign envelope; a completed PDF attachment is fine as well.
- SOC 2: a hosted PDF link or S3 path to the full report is preferred. If you can only share a redacted copy initially, that’s OK — procurement will accept a redacted report for PO issuance but may request an unredacted view for in-person review or an NDA-protected portal.
- Subprocessor list: CSV is perfect. Please include provider name, purpose, locations, and last-assessment date (that matches our template).
- PO routing: once DPA is executed and vendor intake is validated we will create a PO (target within 3 business days). Invoice email / AP address and vendor banking can be included on the intake form or sent to invoices@redwood.com. Include the PO number on the invoice header.

Attachments: I’ve attached a DPA draft (DPA_v2_redlined.pdf) and our preferred subprocessor template (subprocessors_20281115.csv). Also linking to the SOC2 bucket below for procurement’s review.

Next steps for you:
1) Sign the DPA via: https://redwood.app/docusign/azalea-dpa-20281115
2) Upload SOC2 to your preferred secure link and share the URL (or provide a redacted PDF).
3) Return completed subprocessor CSV (attached template) and confirm AP email + remit-to details.

I’m looping in Karthik from procurement to confirm the PO path and timeline. Karthik — can you confirm any PO-specific headers we should call out to Azalea?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Sophie Park <sophie@azaleatech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enablement — Azalea Tech (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Laura — thanks, that is clear and helpful. A couple quick clarifications:
1) SOC 2: we can generate a redacted PDF (client-identifying info removed) and also provide a portal view under NDA. Which should we send first?
2) Subprocessors: we’ll populate the CSV you attached. Does Redwood require the last-assessment date in ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) format?
3) DPA: We noticed a single section with encryption-at-rest language — can you confirm whether you require customer-specific key management (KMS) fields completed now, or if that is handled during Private deployment contracts?

Attached: Azalea_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (completed).

If you prefer I can sign the DPA and upload SOC2 redacted copy today and follow up with the full SOC2 under NDA.

Regards,
Sophie

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@azaleatech.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enablement — Azalea Tech (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Hi Sophie — looping in Priya from security for the encryption/KMS question. Quick procurement notes and PO routing specifics: 

- PO issuance: We will issue a Redwood PO after the DPA is executed and the intake form + subprocessor CSV are received. Target: within 3 business days of completed artifacts.
- PO header: please include the following on invoices so our AP automation matches correctly:
  - Redwood PO Number: (we will provide; temporarily reference PR-2028-115 in communications)
  - Vendor name: Azalea Tech
  - Invoice date and invoice number
  - Line-level description, unit price, quantity, and total
- Invoice submission: invoices@redwood.com (preferred). Please cc procurement@redwood.com on the first invoice so we can reconcile and assign vendor ID.
- Vendor ID: once intake validates we’ll provision a vendor id (format RED-#####). Share W-9 or local equivalent if applicable for tax setup.

Priya — can you comment on the KMS/encryption requirement? If customer-managed keys are required that is typically captured in the Private deployment addendum; for Hosted API the standard DPA language is sufficient unless Azalea will be storing customer data flagged as regulated.

Sophie — if you sign the DocuSign envelope today we’ll start vendor provisioning immediately. I’ve attached the DocuSign link (https://redwood.app/docusign/azalea-dpa-20281115) and the SOC 2 storage path (s3://redwood-security-reports/soc2/2028/soc2_report_2028-09.pdf).

Thanks all — we’ll aim to have the PO out early next week once the DPA is complete.

-Karthik
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@azaleatech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enablement — Azalea Tech (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Hi Sophie — short answer on KMS: for Hosted deployments our DPA encryption-at-rest clause is the baseline we require. If Azalea plans to offer customer-managed KMS to Redwood customers or will be handling customer keys, we’ll need the Private deployment addendum filled out and an architecture diagram; otherwise the standard wording is sufficient.

If you’re unsure, sign the DPA and send the redacted SOC2 PDF now; we can request an NDA-protected unredacted review later.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs referenced: Azalea_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (application/pdf), DPA_v2_redlined.pdf (application/pdf), subprocessors_20281115.csv (text/csv)]
